desc:
🌌 Imperial Tycoon 🌌

Start with an empty plot and a free Credit Tower. Earn credits, build room by room, and create a powerful battle station!

🏗️ Build 200+ upgrades: reactors, shields, hangars, command rooms, armories and more.
⚡ Manage power, grow your Credit Vault and fire your station cannon at planets or rival stations.
🚀 Pilot six unique starfighters, dodge asteroids and make warp jumps.
🪖 Equip six armor sets, grab an energy rifle and battle other players. Defend your station from enemy fighter raids.
🪐 Explore four worlds, capture points for +10% credits, complete quests and unlock permanent research.
🔄 Rebirth 10 times to boost income and unlock new ships and upgrades.

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite to support future updates!

💬 Codes in Discord!
